effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT to the vault, using the signer's USDT allowance to the vault.
The vault mints bbqUSDT shares to `receiver`; the share count comes from the vault's exchange rate at execution, with no minimum in the calldata.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", the USDT amount sent, a constant "Share ticker: bbqUSDT" and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbqUSDT shares the receiver gets; the vault rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: the signer received 279.435734502496147979 bbqUSDT, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbqUSDT'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share count, so the descriptor cannot show it. Keep the receiver and ticker fields.

findings.title: deposit uses the label "Share ticker" for a constant field that does not say shares are received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field: {"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}. Case 0 reader: 'bbqUSDT shares, amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to "Receive shares" and change the intent to "Deposit USDT for bbqUSDT shares".

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDT out amount correctly. The bbqUSDT received has the right asset and receiver but no amount, which is a spec limitation.

effects: The signer sends USDT to the vault. The amount comes from the vault rate at execution (rounded up), and the calldata has no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` bbqUSDT to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", a constant "Deposit asset: USDT" with no amount, the exact bbqUSDT shares minted and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDT leaves the signer; the vault rate decides it, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Case 1: the signer sent 0.000002 USDT, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDT'.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the USDT amount. Change the label to "Pay with (amount set by vault rate)" so the signer knows the amount is not fixed.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say the signer pays USDT into the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: "intent": "Mint". Case 1 reader 'unsure': 'How much USDT will be taken. The screen shows only the share amount'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDT to mint bbqUSDT shares".

cases.notes: The USDT out shows its asset but no amount. The shares went to 0xdead, which is not a signer effect, and the screen shows that correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns bbqUSDT shares from `owner`. The count comes from the vault rate at execution (rounded up), and the calldata has no maximum.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's bbqUSDT allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDT to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", 'Withdraw exactly' with the USDT amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many bbqUSDT shares are burned; the vault rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 2: 0.942138021394557540 bbqUSDT burned from the signer, and no field states it.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share count. Change the intent to "Burn bbqUSDT shares to withdraw USDT".

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDT in exactly, with its receiver. The reader understood that shares are burned but saw no count.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbqUSDT from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends USDT to `receiver`. The amount comes from the vault rate at execution (rounded down), and the calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the exact bbqUSDT shares redeemed, the receiver and the owner. No field names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem does not name USDT as the asset the receiver gets; mint shows the same constant.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`. The redeem format has only `shares`, `receiver` and `owner`, with no `underlyingTicker` field. Case 3 reader 'unsure': 'Which asset is paid out (assumed USDT from the name)'.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem bbqUSDT for USDT".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDT the receiver gets; the vault rate decides it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: the signer received 9.073699 USDT, and no field states it.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the USDT amount. Use the ERC-4626 router with a minimum if a bound is needed.

cases.notes: The screen shows the shares out exactly. For the USDT in, the reader only inferred the asset and had no amount.
